name: tmlr_campaign_20261103
purpose: Confirmatory campaign: worlds A and B x hidden coupling off/on at confounding strength 1.0, eps 0.08, noise 0.25; tabular and gradient-boosted regimes on the same logs; independent reference replicates; selection over four candidates.

analysis.units: US$ per decision, month-0 explorable cohort
per_condition: reference value and Monte-Carlo SE per candidate
mean error +- SE over seeds per regime x estimator x target
selection: picks, resolved/ambiguous counts, regret +- SE, gain vs incumbent, pairwise agreement
contrasts: coupling on - off within each world (seed-paired)
world B - world A within each coupling setting (seed-paired)
gradient-boosted - tabular on the same run
analysis.sensitivity: selection graded with references from the first R' replicates, R' = 1..R
rules: no seed discarded for estimator results or recovery rates
technical failures rerun with identical inputs and recorded
rarity and exploration share recorded, not gated

sizing.rule: pilot/precision_rule.md (fixed before inspection): value SE <= 2.0, paired gap SE <= 1.0 US$/decision per run; smallest R meeting both in the worst pilot run; ceiling 150 CPU-h

gbm_choice: regularized, by the pre-registered reference-free rule (pilot/gbm_selection_rule.md; decision pilot/gbm_selection_decision.json)
bin_approximation: centre-dose vs bin-uniform-dose gaps measured in the development pilot only (pi_near_binU, pi_far_binU; 12 runs); not repeated in confirmation runs
